FABRIC ports, up to 100 m: 400GE QSFP-DD DAC, AEC and AOC cable only - no optical transceiver is listed for them and they connect only to an S9705-48D or S9725-64E. One key covers both blocks because both are qsfp-dd media; which list applies is decided by the group, not by the cage" data-optics-sfp-plus="the two SFP+ management ports are 10G; the datasheet's Compatible Transceiver Types block names QSFP-DD and QSFP28 parts only and lists no SFP+ optic, so what is qualified in these two cages is not stated by the vendor" data-console="RJ45 RS-232 plus a micro-USB serial console, both labelled IOIO" data-oob="1x RJ45 100/1000M" data-inband="2x SFP+ 10G management ports" data-usb="1x USB 2.0 Type-A" data-safety="UL 62368-1; IEC 60950-1; IEC 62368-1; BSMI; NOM" data-emc="FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 55024; EN 55035; EN 62479; EN 50663; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; BSMI; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A; AS/NZS CISPR 32, Class A; Anatel; NEBS GR-1089" data-environment="NEBS GR-63; WEEE; RoHS" data-nebs="NEBS Level 3 (datasheet Key Benefits, 'Ideal for Core, Edge, and Central Office deployments (NEBS Level 3)')" data-eol="none-announced" data-power="ac">
  <style>
    [data-path] { cursor: pointer; }
    .state-on    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-up    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    /* link and up are the same fact on an Ethernet lamp; see docs/rj45-family-design.md */
    .state-link  { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-activity { --led-color: #86efac; }
    .state-ok    { --led-color: #22c55e; }
    .state-fault { --led-color: #ef4444; }
    .state-fail  { --led-color: #ef4444; }
    .state-locate { --led-color: #3b82f6; }
    .state-absent { opacity: 0.35; }
    /* A SWITCHED OUTLET WITH NO LAMP is dimmed when it is off, as absent is but
       less (docs/pdu-model-design.md section 3.2): every switched PDU in the
       library has a lamp per outlet, and this is the fallback so the first one
       without does not invent a lamp. An outlet a lamp is bound to by `for:`
